# BingeWorthy - Edutainment Videos

> BingeWorthy is a curated collection of high-quality edutainment videos from YouTube, organized by channel and category.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://bingeworthyshows.tv/): The main page with new and suggested videos.
- [Categories](https://bingeworthyshows.tv/categories): Browse videos by category.
- [Channels](https://bingeworthyshows.tv/channels): Browse all channels.

## API and Search

- [Search API](/api/search.php): Endpoint for searching videos. Expects a 'q' parameter.
- [Suggestions API](/api/suggested-videos.php): Endpoint for video suggestions.

## Usage Policy

The content on this site is for viewing and entertainment purposes.

### AI Training

User-agent: *
Disallow-training: /

The use of any content on this site for the purpose of training artificial intelligence models is strictly prohibited without prior written consent.
